rows.grounds: compound mahā+vidyā; nominative subject invoking a mahāvidyā
imperative/optative sense expressing a protective invocation
compound parama+īśvarī; epithet qualifying the invoked deity

items.question: Which divine feminine power is invoked to grant protection to the speaker?
premises: Mahāvidyā is named as the invoked protecting power.
Bhagavatī and Parameśvarī qualify this same goddess.
The speaker explicitly requests protection for himself.
items.inference: The venerable Mahāvidyā, the supreme goddess, is invoked to protect the speaker.
uncertainties: Whether mahāvidyā refers to a specific one of the ten mahāvidyās or to the principle collectively is not specified.
items.plain_english: May the venerable Mahāvidyā, the supreme goddess, protect me.
